name: Llíber (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with an open yellow book between two small shields with a horse and fleurs-de-lis, the figures of the municipal arms of Llíber.
history: Municipal flag of Llíber; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: small shields with horse and fleurs-de-lis on white and blue
